messages:
maya: Heads-up: I'm drafting a small follow-up to the precision-RFC about "coalesced precision". main goal: let clients nominate ordered fallback sets while keeping KV/batching caching stable. want to validate interface + ops playbook.

alex: quick q: why not just force the client to choose a single profile and let server decide fallback? less surface area.

maya: two reasons: 1) some customers need per-request control (customer A wants int8 first, B wants fp8), 2) we can leverage client knowledge to avoid unnecessary safe-path fallbacks (eg very short prompts tolerate int8).

liam: ok. concrete proposal?

maya: API change minimal: add `precision_candidates: [string]` to Request proto. server will call Normalizer -> CoalesceBucket -> CoalesceKey. Example: `precision_candidates: ["int8:q4", "fp8:scaled", "fp16"]`. normalization rules: limit to 3, canonical alias map, stable sort by (explicit_priority, canonical_rank).

jin: please pin canonical_rank table in schema docs. also, what about ordering semantics? If client gives explicit priorities like `{profile: "int8", priority: 10}` does that affect normalization?

maya: yes. explicit priority wins; absent that we use default rank. normalization pseudo: ```
// input: list of profiles (with optional priority)
canon = map_aliases(input)
sorted = sort_by_priority_then_rank(canon)
clamped = take_first_n(sorted, 3)
profile_bucket = join(clamped, ":")
coalesce_key = sha256(model_id + "|" + route + "|" + profile_bucket)
```

alex: we need to be VERY explicit about hash algorithm and field separators to avoid accidental cache churn. add proto enum for hash version.

liam: ops: if caches are keyed by this coalesce_key we will invalidate huge state when we change normalization. mitigation: versioned coalesce namespace. allow `coalesce_key_v1` and `coalesce_key_v2` and a migration TTL for old entries. also a metric `coalesce_namespace_mismatch_rate`.

jin: runtime behavior: upon receiving coalesce_key server tries preferred precision path. Emit telemetry: `{coalesce_key, chosen_profile, quality_delta_estimate, latency_ms, safety_triggered}`. if quality_delta_estimate > threshold OR safety_triggered then we do: increment bad_count(coalesce_key) and (if bad_count > X in window) move coalesce_key into safety lane (force next N requests to safe_profile e.g. fp16).

maya: add shadow-run sampling to verify safety lane decisions: for safety lane coalesce_keys we run the safe_profile in shadow at sample rate 1% to confirm improvement. report `shadow_mismatch_rate`.

alex: do we surface degradation to clients? i'd prefer a header and SDK-level event not to break existing apps. e.g. `X-Precision-Override: forced-fp16` and `X-Precision-Quality: -0.07`.

liam: agree on header. ops wants an automated rollback if global safety hits > 0.5% of requests or if coalesce_key_churn > 2% over 5m. also need an alert `precision_coalesce_surge` when the number of unique coalesce_keys created per minute spikes.

maya: rollout plan: phase 0: proto + docs + logging only for 48h. phase 1: enable normalization + logging (no enforcement) for 48h. phase 2: shadow-run for 1% traffic for 72h with telemetry dashboards. phase 3: automatic safety-lane enforcement for 5% canary. phase 4: ramp.

jin: test plan: fuzz permutations of aliases to assert normalization is idempotent; snapshot tests for coalesce_key outputs; e2e load test with artificial client permutations to measure key cardinality. CI should include permutations fuzz test with seeded RNG.

liam: ops-runbook snippet: when safety lane triggered: 1) mark coalesce_key as safety-locked, 2) create incident with traces & last 100 requests, 3) enable 1% shadow-run if not enabled, 4) optionally apply customer override to force back to safe profile permanently.

maya: one last UX note: SDKs should expose `precisionCandidates` helpers that canonicalize aliases client-side to reduce server churn. add `normalize_client_side: bool` in proto to let SDK opt-in.

ops-bot: Checklist: reviewers=[maya, alex, liam], unit tests for normalizer, fuzz tests, telemetry dashboards, alert rules. CI: add permutations test + deterministic hash vector. :white_check_mark:

alex: SGTM. maya open PR and tag ops. we'll review tomorrow 10:00.

maya: will do, thanks everyone.
